page0.text:
I refuse to abandon someone when they're down.
That's how I've always lived my life.
And most importantly, I can't leave the girl who fought so hard to protect me.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page0:1

page1.text:
"Okay Berserker. She's going to regenerate, so take her out now."
Berserker rumbles back into movement.
I...
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page1:1

page2.text:
"Why YOUUUUUU!!!"
I run forward as fast as I can.
I can't possibly do anything against that monster.
But the least I can do is to get Saber out of the way and save her from Berserker's atta—
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page2:1

page3.text:
"Eh?"
I fall.
Why?
I was going to shove Saber away from Berserker. Then I'd figure out what to do afterward...so why?
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page3:1

page4.text:
"Gahhk..."
Why...?
Why am I on the ground, unable to breathe?
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page4:1

page5.text:
"!?"
I hear surprised voices.
First is Saber, who is in front of me now.
Then there's Tohsaka, standing at a distance, looking aghast.
And then for some reason, the girl calling herself Illya stares down at me, dumbfounded.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page5:1

page6.text:
"Hu...h...?"
There's a gaping, ragged hole in the middle of my body.
I'm on the ground.
On the asphalt. There's only a little blood considering how big the wound is. I see some withered, branch-looking things and some shattered...stuff, and...man, that looks painful, all those parts...scattered around...
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page6:1

page7.text:
"I get it. How dumb am I?"
So I didn't make it.
I could never have pushed Saber away, so I was just her shield.
And then that ungodly huge machete-thing took a good chunk out of my stomach.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page7:1

page8.text:
"Gahhk..."
I can't believe I failed at a time like this.
I tried my best to be a hero of justice, but I screwed it all up when it really mattered.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page8:1

page9.text:
"Why?"
The silver-haired girl's face is blank as she speaks.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page9:1

page10.text:
After standing there dumbfounded, she just says,
"I've had enough. This is boring."
She calls Berserker back without finishing Saber off.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page10:1

page11.text:
"Rin. I'll kill you the next time we meet."
The girl leaves.
After she disappears, I completely black out.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page11:1

page12.text:
I lose consciousness.
I'm really dead this time.
I somehow survived when Lancer killed me last time, but my luck's definitely run out.
There's no magecraft that could save a person who just lost half his body.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page12:1

page13.text: "Wh-what were you thinking!? Don't you know I can't save you anymore!"
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page13:1

page14.text:
I hear a voice reprimanding me.
It must be Tohsaka. She sounds like she's really mad, and I feel bad.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-07:page14:1
